description: Atelier hooks: inside an Atelier session that has run too long, remind it to hand over (issue #29); in a main Claude Code session in a project with a live Atelier server, once it writes more than 3 files (past the quickfix lane), remind it to hand normal and risky work to a lead, again every 30 minutes (issues #31, #33, #769). Neither blocks a tool. The /agents mod (agents.tsx, issue #755) shows Atelier agent teams in a pane and the status line, read only.
